summary_en: This study tests tart cherry juice, given at a high dose or a low dose, to see whether it can prevent peripheral neuropathy, a nerve side effect, caused by paclitaxel chemotherapy in people with breast or ovarian cancer. Patients take tart cherry juice concentrate diluted in water up to 8 oz, by mouth, either 1 oz (high dose) or ¼ oz (low dose), and how long or how often they take it is not stated. The record does not state the main outcome measure; this is a Phase 2 randomized study.
summary_es: Este estudio prueba jugo de cereza ácida, en dosis alta o baja, para ver si puede prevenir la neuropatía periférica, un efecto secundario en los nervios, causado por la quimioterapia con paclitaxel en personas con cáncer de mama o de ovario. Los pacientes toman concentrado de jugo de cereza ácida diluido en agua hasta 8 oz, por vía oral, ya sea 1 oz (dosis alta) o ¼ oz (dosis baja), y no se indica por cuánto tiempo ni con qué frecuencia lo toman. El registro no indica la medida principal de resultado; es un estudio aleatorizado de Fase 2.
who_for: Invasive breast or ovarian cancer, stage I to IV
ECOG 0-1 or Karnofsky score of 70% or higher
Willing to avoid any other cherry or cherry juice during the study
not_for: Prior taxane, vinca alkaloid, eribulin, ixabepilone, or platinum therapy
Active or past peripheral neuropathy, or chronic diseases linked to it such as diabetes
Taking certain listed supplements or medicines unless agreed to stop at registration
